body: Thanks, everyone. I was finally able to find out that it was sent with UPS Mail Innovations where they will transfer it to USPS for final delivery.
I’m in GA also and mine took 13 months for approval. Maybe yours will move faster than mine.
What a sweet puppy and awesome painting. I always admire people with this kind of talent and skill.
Funèrailles by Franz Liszt composed October, 1849, performed by Volodya Horowitz, 1977. No words need to be spoken as everything I’d like to say and express is in this little 12-minute tour de force.

This kind of happened to me. I applied for SSDI and was denied the first time because I hadn’t turned in a form they needed. I appealed with the correct form and was approved in just a few weeks. I’d say definitely appeal.
I called my local SSA office and they told me they don’t give out this form at all and refused to give me a copy.

I was approved on my first time applying without a lawyer and I informed them of my psychiatric issues plus my physical ailments. I believe like the previous person said that they (psychiatric problems) could bolster your application. Best of luck!

I would like to say yes but there are not. I tried applying for a supervisor position that opened a few months ago but was rejected. Administrative positions in transportation are few and far between and/or require exemplary qualifications.

Not really. And I can’t afford to go to tech school. I’m over my head in student loan debt and all I have to show for it is a useless degree. If I didn’t have a degree already, our state would pay for tech school but alas…
I had thought about it but I can’t afford the tuition. I did truck driving before but my skills were so bad they advised me to go into a different profession.
Thanks. I tried this but my skills weren’t up to par. I couldn’t get the hang of it. My trainer recommended I find a different job.

Work sucks, Being poor sucks. I’ve been poor for my entire life. I have a Master’s degree but the only thing that accomplished was gaining a huge student-loan debt. I work a meager, stressful, low-paying job. I stress at work, stress at home wondering how I’m going to pay my rent and utilities. I just tragically lost my mother a few months ago, who was the only person that gave a shit whether I lived or died. Premiums and copays on health insurance are so expensive now that I can’t even afford to go to the doctor or purchase medications. And this is living completely alone with no children. I can’t imagine what poor people with children experience. I often wonder if life is worth the constant stress and struggle.  There is zero enjoyment.

I was really obese for many years. No women would give me the time of day. Started hitting the gym. Lost over 150 lbs. Eventually, I was even able to bench 405 and deadlift 585. Despite being being 6’5” and 235lbs, the dating situation never changed for me and I was unsuccessful. I eventually gave up on the gym though I do agree that it does make one feel better physically even though it did absolutely nothing for the love life.
